Intent: shoppers submit payment and receive an order confirmation.
Flow: enter cardholder name, card number, expiry, and security code; submit; then confirmation.
Reuse `Button` from `src/ui/Button.jsx` for Pay.
Pending: submission disables Pay, changes its accessible name to Processing, and announces progress once.
Error: show one inline payment error associated with the invalid field, move focus to the error summary, then allow retry.
Adaptation: below the existing `md` breakpoint from `tailwind.config.js`, stack fields in source order and keep Pay after the last field; at and above `md`, use two columns while preserving the same order.
Accessibility: every field has a persistent label and described error; the error summary is announced once and receives focus; reuse the active system focus and target-size behavior.
No new primitive or system delta is required.
